hello.g50: Fine, I'll pretend I didn't miss you.

hello.g54: Go on, add more RGB. You know you want to.
hello.g55: 16.8 million colors and I still pick you.

hello.g58: Set the mood, set the lights.

hello.g65: Stay cool. Your fans already do.
